settings.readOnly: Read-only: changes are made by the central committee.

delays.title: Claim delay per band
delays.help: After this delay without a claim the report becomes late and the centre may answer it (defaults: 60 s critical, 90 s high, 120 s normal, 180 s low).
delays.order: Delays must satisfy critical ≤ high ≤ normal ≤ low.

bands.title: Urgency band thresholds
bands.help: Minimum priority score (0–100) of each band; below “normal” the band is low.

quota.title: Anonymous report quota
quota.help: Accepted reports per installation before registration is required. SOS is never refused and 198 is always available.
quota.label: Reports

accuracy.title: Trusted location accuracy
accuracy.help: A location less accurate than this goes to geographic verification.
accuracy.label: Maximum

validation.order: The values are in the wrong order.

release.title: Mobile app release
release.help: Version offered to the phones. Below the latest build the app shows “What's new” with “Update” and “Later”; below the minimum build the update cannot be skipped (SOS and 198 stay reachable).
release.mandatoryNote: Raise the minimum build only for a security or data fix: older phones then must update before going on.

errors.version: The version is written as three numbers: 0.3.0.
errors.build: Build numbers are whole numbers between {{min}} and {{max}}.
errors.order: The minimum build cannot be above the latest build.
errors.url: The download address must start with https://.
errors.urlMissing: A release on our server needs its download address.
errors.notes: Each text has at most {{notes}} characters.

moderation.title: Words refused in names and comments
moderation.help: Added to the built-in list. Applied to profile names and other non-emergency text; never to reports, SOS or descriptions.
moderation.label: One word or expression per line

accessInfoDays.title: Deadline for access to information
accessInfoDays.help: Days the Office has to answer a request for access to information sent through “Contact us” (law 2016-22, art. 14: 20 days). To be confirmed by the legal service.
accessInfoDays.label: Deadline

liveMax.title: Live location: longest share
liveMax.help: How long a citizen can share their live location with their contacts in one go.
liveMax.label: Longest share

checkMax.title: Safety check: longest duration
checkMax.help: The longest time a citizen can set before their contacts are alerted if they do not answer.
checkMax.label: Longest duration

locationHistory.title: 72-hour location history
locationHistory.help: Lets citizens who opt in keep their positions for 72 hours, so an operations room can find a missing person. Off by default.
locationHistory.label: Turn on the location history
locationHistory.note: While off, the app hides the feature and the missing-person search does not appear. Turning it off later stops collection; points already kept are erased after 72 hours.

accounts.title: Room accounts
accounts.introNational: Accounts of every gouvernorat and the central room.
accounts.requiredActions: At first sign-in: password, two-factor authentication and email confirmation.
accounts.invalid: Fill in the required fields and choose at least one role.
accounts.caption: Accounts list

audit.title: Regional audit log
audit.intro: Operations of {{name}}, with unnecessary data redacted.
audit.caption: Audit log

breakGlass.title: Break-glass request
breakGlass.intro: Read-only and time-limited. Every view is audited and reviewed by security.
breakGlass.pageIntroOwn: Your break-glass grants and their review.
breakGlass.pageIntroReviewer: Every break-glass grant. Review each one after it ends (nobody reviews their own).

review.title: Review the grant
review.selfNote: You cannot review your own grant.

reporterMask.notice: The reporter's identity is masked: only the handling room, or break-glass access, can see it.

layers.title: Map data layers
layers.intro: Each layer is a set of places loaded from a file (CSV, Excel, JSON or GeoJSON): hospitals, pharmacies, shelters… Check the preview before publishing; the last import can be undone.
layers.truncated: Too many places in this area, zoom in: {{names}}

template.title: Empty template with the recognised columns:

form.keyHelp: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and _; cannot change after creation.
form.staffOnly: Columns never sent to the app
form.staffOnlyHelp: Comma-separated. Default: manager (name of the person in charge).
form.toVerify: Data to be verified (shown with “To be verified”)
form.editorsAllowed: Content editors may import into this layer

errors.name: The name is required in the three languages.
errors.colour: Choose a colour from the list.

form.simulated: Approximate trial data [SIM]: invented places, public only for a trial

import.title: Import a file
import.fileHelp: CSV, Excel, JSON or GeoJSON, at most {{size}} and {{rows}} rows. First row: column names (name, latitude and longitude required).
import.mergeHelp: adds new places, updates existing ones by identifier, keeps the others.
import.replaceHelp: the file becomes the whole layer: places missing from it are removed.
import.previewTitle: Preview of {{file}} (nothing changed on the map yet)
import.warningsTitle: Warnings ({{count}}): the place is kept without the field
import.mapLabel: Preview map: new, updated and removed places
import.replaceWarning: {{count}} places missing from the file will be removed.

reasons.not_a_point: The geometry is not a point

history.title: Import history
history.undoExplain: The layer goes back to how it was before this import.

guide.title: Emergency hub: topics and items
guide.intro: Each topic (fires, fractures, first aid, breathing problems…) holds items. The app shows them in this order and keeps them offline.
guide.simNotice: [SIM] The first texts come from published first-aid guidance and are not official: each item not validated shows in the app under the “awaiting medical validation” banner until the Office’s medical staff validates it.

item.title: Title
item.linesHelp: One line per entry. Steps are required in each language (15 at most).
item.call198: Show the “Call 198” button on this item
item.validateExplain: Name in the reason the doctor or service who validated the text.
item.revalidate: Changing the text withdraws the current medical validation.

errors.title: The title is required ({{lang}}).
errors.tooLong: Line too long, 300 characters at most ({{lang}}).

contact.title: Contact us: requests
contact.intro: Requests sent from the app: access to information (law 2016-22, with its legal deadline), non-urgent hazards, questions, suggestions, app problems and partnerships. This is not an emergency channel: the app tells citizens to call 198.
contact.subject: Subject
contact.truncated: Only the first 500 requests are listed: narrow the filters.
contact.anonymous: No contact details (answer in the app only)
contact.noteHint: Internal note: never shown to the requester.
contact.visibleHint: This text is shown to the requester in the app.

medical.title: Medical file attached
medical.intro: The reporter chose to attach their medical file to this report. It is shown only on request, and each opening is recorded in the audit log.
medical.audited: This opening has been recorded in the audit log.

history.title: Missing person: location history
history.intro: Search the last 72 hours of positions of a person linked to this report, if they turned the history on. The person is told through the app.
history.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number (8 to 20 digits).
history.audited: Each search is recorded in the audit log, even when nothing is found.
history.noPoints: The history is on, but no position was kept in the last 72 hours.
history.notEnabled: This person has not turned the location history on.

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.intro: Doctors who registered from the app, pending registrations first. Check the medical council registration number (and a Civil Protection doctor's staff number) before verifying: no medical file reaches an unverified doctor.

detail.audited: Opening this file is recorded in the audit log.

review.title: Verification
review.check: Check the number with the medical council, and call the doctor if needed, before verifying.
